I sent Dana her answer in our DM. Moss's notes mention two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. It was patched on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)". The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for firmware testing.

The 14 Sep 2025 and 23 Mar 2026 notes mention Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers. The two Central team notes don't mention Quarrendon at all; I checked them through the knowledge brain rather than opening the files. I also warned her that the cheat sheet says not to confuse Quarrendon with Quarendon Freightways, which isn't a customer.

I also pointed Dana to ticket **#4912**, which isn't in Moss's notes. It's listed as open on the Quarrendon account page, which Dana can see because she owns the account. It's for slow loading of the `Gate_Dwell_Daily` report at the Superior yard.

The search also turned up a few things I left out of the reply:
